verdict.rationale: The pack documents no user-facing way to select or act on many items at once: no bulk upload, batch API, or mass case actions. The closest items are adjacent. A TIN report is described as "ideal" for bulk KYB without any bulk mechanism being documented. Daily ongoing screening is a recurring automated job, not a user-performed bulk action. AI agents auto-clearing matches is automation, not a bulk operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
